newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open down sharply.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open down sharply.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were called to open down sharply Thursday as gold and the platinum group metals (PGMs) were lackluster overnight.
Dealers in Europe said gold could test the lows as players lost patience over the failure to make any significant gains recently. Panic in the PGMs also appeared to wane.
COMEX August gold was called $2.00 to $2.50 lower from Wednesday's close of $346.00 an ounce. Bullion was fixed this morning in London at $341.80, down $2.00 from the Wednesday afternoon fix.
